## THE IDEA (one paragraph, no more)

The notebook game everyone played in school, but with a combo counter and a bot that punishes a careless chain.

## THIS GAME'S SPECIFICS

- Why it deserves a tile: it has a real strategic layer - the DOUBLE-CROSS sacrifice (give your opponent a short chain so they must open a long one for you). Depth with zero luck.
- Build: grid sizes as data (4x4 beginner, 6x6 standard, 8x8 expert), tap a gap to draw a line, a box completion animation with a colour wash in the owner's colour, a CHAIN-COMBO counter that escalates sound and pitch per box in a run, and a "one more box!" pulse. In 2-4 player mode every line keeps its owner's colour so the board stays readable.
- Bots: greedy first (always take a free box), then chain-aware - count chains, avoid opening a long chain, use the double-cross when behind on parity. That progression gives three difficulty tiers for free.
- Optional twists (pick at most one): a bonus box worth 3, a rare bomb line that clears adjacent claimed boxes, or a timed Blitz mode.
- Banner ads only. Full entry: FuturePlans/GAME_IDEAS.md section 6.12.

## HARD REQUIREMENTS (our shell stack - all mandatory)

1. ONE self-contained `.html`. All CSS, JS and art inline.
2. ZERO network calls at runtime: no CDNs, no external fonts, no analytics, no remote images.
   It must run perfectly from `file://` with the device offline.
3. Size budget: Tier 1 - see `CONTRACT.md` §2 (T1 <= 300 KB, T2 <= 450 KB, T3 <= 1 MB).
4. `STUDIO_GAME_MANIFEST` comment block with exactly these keys -
   `id / title / orientation / minPlayers / maxPlayers / aiSupport / online / tileColor / version`
   - values: `proposed: id dots-and-boxes / portrait / minPlayers 1 / maxPlayers 4 / aiSupport true / online false / tileColor graphite/violet / version 1`.
5. `window.Game` lifecycle with a simulation clock: `pause()`, `resume()`, `destroy()`.
   Pausing must freeze all timers, animation and audio; nothing may keep simulating in the
   background.
6. Studio SDK block, wrapped so the game runs fully when the native bridge is absent
   (browser test).
7. Ads ONLY through the shell bridge (banner + rewarded); a rewarded callback that arrives
   with no argument means GRANTED. If the device is offline, show a plain "check your
   internet connection" message - NEVER a simulated or fake ad.
8. Audio and vibration obey the shell settings (master sound, volume, vibration, haptic
   profile): no game sound may play when master sound is off. `Game.setSettings` receives
   `sound` / `haptics` / `volume` from the shell.
9. User-facing copy: plain text, no em dashes and no "--" anywhere in the UI.
10. Orientation portrait, with safe-area insets handled (notches, rounded corners).
11. Every inline `<script>` block must parse - verified with the syntax gate below.

## DO NOT

- Change the shell, add a second file, add a dependency, phone home, or invent gameplay
  beyond the idea above.
- Touch any file other than the target file (and, when the entry says so, the manifest
  block inside it).
- Launch the app or the game yourself. Build and install only; the director tests on device.

## DONE MEANS

- `node Tools/_check_js_syntax.js new file: app/src/main/assets/games/dots-and-boxes/index.html` -> `ALL SCRIPTS PARSE OK`.
- `BUILD.bat` -> `BUILD OK - shell-debug.apk`, and only then `adb install -r shell-debug.apk`.
- Grid + line/box model correct at all three sizes, the greedy and chain-aware bots both feel right on device, and the combo escalation is audible.
- `FuturePlans/GAME_IDEAS.md` status updated (and `PROGRESS.md` current state if the game shipped).
